title: Delete Characters to Make Fancy String
summary: A fancy string has no three consecutive identical characters.
statement: A fancy string has no three consecutive identical characters. Given a string, remove the least number of characters to ensure it becomes fancy, returning the resulting string.
constraints: s has 1 through 100000 lowercase English letters.
Delete the minimum characters so no three consecutive result characters are equal.
Preserve the relative order of all retained characters.
hints: Within each equal-character run, keeping its first two characters is both sufficient and maximal.
Scan left to right and append unless the last two retained characters already equal the current one.
A third run character must be deleted in every valid result, while deleting either of the first two is unnecessary. Applying this independently to each run minimizes deletions.
editorial: A third run character must be deleted in every valid result, while deleting either of the first two is unnecessary. Applying this independently to each run minimizes deletions.

tests.explanation: Removing one e from the run eee produces leetcode.
Keeping at most two characters from each a-run produces aabaa.
